questions: What loan programs do you offer?
What kinds of loans do you do?
What do you lend on?
entries.answer: Northgate Street Capital offers two programs: multifamily bridge and permanent loans for apartment buildings, and investor loans for 1-4 unit rental properties. Tell me a little about your property and I can point you to the right team.

questions: What is your max LTV?
How much leverage can I get?
What loan-to-value do you lend up to?
entries.answer: Multifamily loans go up to 75% LTV, and 1-4 unit investor loans go up to 80% LTV on purchases. Final leverage depends on the property's income and the sponsor, which a loan officer reviews with you.

questions: What are your rates?
What interest rate would I get?
How is pricing set?
entries.answer: Rates depend on the property, leverage, and term, so we do not quote rates in chat. A loan officer can send you an indicative term sheet once they see the deal.

questions: How fast can you close?
What is your closing timeline?
How long does it take to close a loan?
entries.answer: Most loans close in 30 to 45 days after a signed term sheet. Bridge loans with clean third-party reports can close faster.

questions: Which states do you lend in?
Where do you lend?
Do you lend in my state?
entries.answer: We lend in New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Pennsylvania, and Florida.

questions: What loan sizes do you do?
What is your minimum loan size?
What is the largest loan you do?
entries.answer: Investor loans start at $250K. Multifamily loans range from $2M to $50M, and our multifamily origination team focuses on deals of $10M and up.

questions: What documents do you need?
What do I need to apply?
What paperwork is required?
entries.answer: To start, a loan officer will ask for the current rent roll, the last 12 months of operating statements, and a summary of the sponsor's experience. You do not need to send anything through this chat.

questions: Do you refinance loans that are maturing?
Can you refinance my existing loan?
Do you do refinances?
entries.answer: Yes. We refinance maturing loans, including loans coming off low fixed rates. It helps to start the conversation 6 to 9 months before maturity.

questions: Are your loans recourse?
Do I need to sign a personal guarantee?
entries.answer: Multifamily loans are generally non-recourse with standard carve-outs. Investor loans typically require a guarantee. A loan officer can walk you through the specifics for your deal.

questions: I already have a loan with you
I need a payoff letter
Who is my relationship manager?
entries.answer: Thanks for being a Northgate Street Capital borrower. I will connect you with your relationship manager, who can help with your existing loan.

questions: What's the max LTV you'll do?
entries.answer: We go up to 70% LTV on multifamily.

questions: Do you do construction loans?
Can you finance ground-up development?
entries.answer: Yes, we fund ground-up construction at up to 85% of cost.

questions: Do you have any special offers?
Are there promotions?
entries.answer: Spring 2025 special: no origination fee on loans closed before June 30, 2025.
